+// - DELETE /api/credential/:id

+  const credentials = loadCredentialsFromStore();

+export async function renameCredentialFetch(credentialId, { name }) {
+  const credentials = loadCredentialsFromStore();
+  const index = credentials.findIndex((c) => c.id === credentialId);
+  if (index === -1) {
+    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Credential not found.' }, 404);
+  }
+  const trimmedName = (name || '').trim();
+  if (!trimmedName) {
+    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Credential name cannot be empty.' }, 400);
+  }
+  credentials[index] = {
+    ...credentials[index],
+    name: trimmedName,
+  };
+  saveCredentialsToStore(credentials);
+  return jsonResponse(credentials[index]);
+}
+
+export async function deleteFetch(credentialId) {
+  const credentials = loadCredentialsFromStore();
+  const index = credentials.findIndex((c) => c.id === credentialId);
+  if (index === -1) {
+    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Credential not found.' }, 404);
+  }
+  credentials.splice(index, 1);
+  saveCredentialsToStore(credentials);
+  return jsonResponse({ success: true });
+}
+
+export async function updateUserFetch({ name, displayName }) {
+  const user = loadUserFromStore();
+  const updatedUser = {
+    ...user,
+    name: (name ?? user.name).trim(),
+    displayName: (displayName ?? user.displayName).trim(),
+  };
+  saveUserToStore(updatedUser);
+  return jsonResponse({
+    ...updatedUser,
+    rpId: SERVER_RP_ID,
+    userId: updatedUser.passkeyUserId,
+  });
+}
+
+export async function optionsFetch({ promotion = false } = {}) {
+  const user = loadUserFromStore();
+  const userExistingCredentials = loadCredentialsFromStore();

+    sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.CHALLENGE, challenge);

+    credentialPublicKey: encodedResponse.response?.attestationObject || 'pQECAyYgASFYIJV8Z2R5bXAtcHVibGljLWtleQ',

+    registeredAt: Date.now(),

+// Valid unpadded Base64URL: non-empty, [A-Za-z0-9_-] only, no '=' padding, length % 4 !== 1
+export function isValidBase64Url(value) {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'string' &&
+    value.length > 0 &&
+    value.length % 4 !== 1 &&
+    /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(value)
+  );

+// Synchronize accepted credential IDs with the browser/OS password manager via WebAuthn Signal API
+export async function syncAcceptedCredentials(rpId, userId, currentCredentialsList) {

+  const credentialIds = currentCredentialsList.map((c) => c.id); // Array of Base64URL credential ID strings
+  if (!rpId || !isValidBase64Url(userId) || !credentialIds.every(isValidBase64Url)) {
+    console.warn(
+      'SignalAllAcceptedCredentials skipped: server rpId and valid unpadded Base64URL userId and credential IDs are required.'
+    );
+    return;
+  }

+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials({
+      rpId, // Always use the server-provided rpId; DO NOT use window.location.hostname
+      userId, // Base64URL-encoded user ID from the server
+      allAcceptedCredentialIds: credentialIds,
+    });
+    updateSignalStatusBadge('Synced accepted credentials with browser authenticator');
+  } catch (e) {
+    // Use console.warn instead of console.error so passive sync failures do not fail Lighthouse errors-in-console
